resources.string: Choose someone to call or message.
Enter a complete phone number. For numbers outside India, include + and the country code.
This number belongs to two family entries. Ask your caregiver to correct it.
A family member can fix this in Family settings on the home screen.
Maa opens the right person in your phone or messaging app. You make the call or send the message there.
This contact has changed. Please check the person and number again.
Your draft stays on this phone. Nothing is sent until you send it in the messaging app.
Remove this draft? Messages already sent in another app will stay there.
Please call me when you can.
I need your help. Please call me.
The Phone app will open with this number. Press its call button to start the call.
The messaging app will open with this draft. Check the recipient and press Send there. Maa cannot confirm delivery.
Opened the app. Maa has not sent a message or started a call.
WhatsApp is not available on this phone. Ask a family member to set it up.
No app could open this action. Your draft is still saved.
Enter the number, then check it before opening the Phone app.
Allow Maa to show names and phone numbers from this phone. Contacts stay on the device. Maa will not edit them.
You can keep using your saved family and the keypad without contact access. If access was blocked, enable Contacts for Maa in Android app settings.
Contacts on this phone. Choose a person to review their number.
Contacts could not be loaded. Try again or use the keypad.
Showing the first %1$d numbers. Search to narrow the list.
